verdict.rationale: Superpowers is described as a Claude-Code-style plugin/skills system that repeatedly pauses for human approval (brainstorming step asks the user what they're trying to do, 'every path still stops for your approval before implementation', worktree conflicts ask rather than force) — this is an interactive workflow, and no evidence pack item mentions a headless mode, CI flag, non-interactive invocation, or automation pipeline usage.
